peoples.label: English
peoples.note: English colonists, provincial soldiers and regulars.

peoples.label: Scots-Irish
peoples.note: Ulster Scots settlers of the backcountry.

peoples.label: French
peoples.note: Canadiens, habitants, troupes de la marine and coureurs de bois.

peoples.label: Palatine German
peoples.note: German Palatine settlers of the Mohawk and Schoharie valleys (German Flatts, Stone Arabia).

peoples.label: Dutch (Albany)
peoples.note: Dutch-descended families of Albany, Schenectady and the Hudson valley.

peoples.label: Spanish
peoples.note: Spaniards of Florida (St. Augustine, Pensacola), New Spain and the Caribbean: soldiers, sailors, missionaries and traders of the Atlantic world.

peoples.label: Haudenosaunee
peoples.note: The Six Nations: Mohawk (Kanien'keha:ka), Oneida, Onondaga, Cayuga, Seneca and Tuscarora; the Mohawk valley is Kanien'keha:ka country.

peoples.label: Lenape
peoples.note: The Lenape (Delaware), by the 1750s living on the Susquehanna and in the Ohio country.

peoples.label: Shawnee
peoples.note: Shawnee towns of the Ohio country and the Susquehanna.

peoples.label: Wabanaki
peoples.note: Abenaki, Penobscot, Maliseet, Mi'kmaq and Passamaquoddy of the northeast.

peoples.label: West African
peoples.note: Akan, Yoruba, Igbo, Mande, Wolof and other West African peoples; free and enslaved Africans lived in Albany, Schenectady and on the valley's estates.

peoples.label: Central African
peoples.note: Kongo, Mbundu and other peoples of West-Central Africa.

peoples.label: African American
peoples.note: Colonial-born people of African descent, free and enslaved, often of mixed West and Central African (and sometimes European or Native) ancestry.

peoples.label: Ethiopian
peoples.note: Amhara, Tigrayan and Oromo peoples of the Ethiopian highlands, the kingdom ruled from Gondar; the land where coffee first grew.

peoples.label: Japanese
peoples.note: People of Japan; castaways from Japanese ships reached the Pacific coast of North America.

peoples.label: Chinese
peoples.note: People of Qing China; Chinese sailors and artisans were in the Manila and Atlantic trades.

peoples.label: Korean
peoples.note: People of Joseon Korea.

peoples.label: South Asian
peoples.note: People of Bengal, the Deccan, Gujarat and beyond; lascar sailors crewed East India ships.

peoples.label: Filipino
peoples.note: People of the Philippines; 'Manila men' sailed the galleon trade to the Americas.

peoples.label: Vietnamese
peoples.note: People of Dai Viet, divided between the Trinh lords (north) and the Nguyen lords (south).

peoples.label: Thai (Siamese)
peoples.note: Siamese of the kingdom of Ayutthaya, a trading port with Chinese, Malay, Portuguese and Dutch quarters.

peoples.label: Malay
peoples.note: Malays of the peninsula and Sumatra (Johor-Riau, Kedah, Dutch Malacca), traders and sailors of the Straits.

peoples.label: Pacific Islander
peoples.note: Peoples of the Pacific islands (Tahiti and the Society Islands, Hawaii, Tonga, Samoa, Aotearoa); Mai of Raiatea sailed to London in 1774.

peoples.label: Levantine
peoples.note: People of the eastern Mediterranean (Syria, Lebanon, Palestine): traders and sailors.

peoples.label: Ottoman Turkish
peoples.note: Turks of Anatolia and Rumelia, subjects of the Ottoman sultan in Istanbul: soldiers, merchants and sailors of the Mediterranean.

peoples.label: Persian
peoples.note: People of Iran after the Safavids (Nader Shah died in 1747; Karim Khan Zand ruled from Shiraz from 1751); Persian silk and carpet merchants reached Russia, India and Europe.

peoples.label: Arab
peoples.note: Arabs of the Arabian peninsula and Iraq: Bedouin of the desert, townspeople of the Hejaz and Basra, and the merchants of Mocha, the coffee port of Yemen.

peoples.label: Armenian
peoples.note: Armenians of the Caucasus, Anatolia and New Julfa in Isfahan; their merchant houses traded from Amsterdam and London to Madras and Manila.

peoples.label: Kurdish
peoples.note: Kurds of the Zagros and Taurus mountains, between the Ottoman and Persian empires: herders, farmers and the horsemen of the emirates (Baban, Bohtan, Ardalan).

peoples.label: North African
peoples.note: Amazigh (Berber) peoples of the Maghreb: the Rif, the Atlas, Kabylia and the Sahara's edge.

peoples.label: Moorish (Morocco)
peoples.note: The Moors: Arabic-speaking townspeople of Morocco (Fez, Tetouan, Rabat-Sale), many of Andalusi descent after the expulsions from Spain (1609-1614); merchants, envoys and corsairs.

peoples.label: Egyptian
peoples.note: Egyptians of the Nile valley and delta, Muslim and Coptic, under Ottoman pashas and the Mamluk beys; Cairo and Alexandria traded coffee, cloth and grain.

peoples.label: French and Native (Metis)
peoples.note: Families of French and Native descent, common in the fur trade and on the lakes.

peoples.label: African and Native
peoples.note: Families of African and Native descent, found in many northeastern communities.

peoples.label: European and African
peoples.note: People of European and African descent.
